items.prompt: Why is the vowel of כָּל short here?
items.answer_raw: maqqeph has taken away its accent

items.prompt: What does the raised hyphen do?
items.answer_raw: binds the words so that only the last keeps its accent

items.prompt: How many accents do these two words have?
The object marker אֵת stands here as אֶת. Why?
items.answer_raw: joined by maqqeph, it lost its accent and its vowel shortened

items.prompt: What does the small vertical stroke beside the first vowel mark?
items.answer_raw: a secondary stress, so the vowel is not hurried over

items.prompt: Does the metheg change the sound of the vowel?
items.answer_raw: does not change it; it only keeps it from being slurred
